Hurricane Polo Intensifies to Category 5 Storm

Hurricane Polo has rapidly intensified into a Category 5 storm off Mexico's Pacific coast. It is expected to bring heavy rain to parts of southwestern Mexico, including Guerrero and Michoacán, through Thursday. The storm's rapid intensification is described as historic. Potential impacts on California and Arizona are also being monitored.
